audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race between deduplication check (hasSeenDataColumnIndex at L157) and cache update (setSeenDataColumnIndex in subscriber at L42). Validation checks cache but doesn't set it; subscriber sets cache AFTER validation completes. Concurrent gossip messages for same (slot, proposer_index, index) can both pass validation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends identical data column sidecars for same (slot, proposer_index, index) to multiple peers simultaneously via P2P gossip. Both messages enter validateDataColumn concurrently, both check hasSeenDataColumnIndex (both get false), both pass validation, both call ValidationAccept. First subscriber call sets cache, but second already passed the check. Result: duplicate processing, wasted resources, potential cache/state corruption.
